text.label: Text: Someone with a problem right now fills in your…
text.value: Someone who wants what you teach sends a DM or fills in your form, and then waits. Most people answer in hours. Some answer the next day. By then that person has already bought from somebody else.

text.label: Text: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the…
text.value: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the sale you did not make, because nobody ever knew that person was interested in the first place. It is the most expensive leak in your business and it is invisible, which is exactly why it never gets fixed. More attention makes it worse, not better. Double the followers into a slow reply and all you have doubled is the unread messages.

props.text: This is what happens at 11:40 on a Saturday night.
A message comes in while you are asleep, on stage, or having dinner. Nobody on your team sees it until Monday. By then they have bought from someone else.

props.caption: An illustration of the exchange, not a follower's real thread. The point is the timing: the reply goes out in under a minute, every time, whether or not anyone is awake.

messages.text: Hi, I just finished your book. Is your coaching program still open? What does it cost?
Yes, enrolment is open. It depends on which track fits you, so let me ask two quick things and I can point you to the right one.
First, are you just getting started or already selling? And would you rather work in the group or one-on-one?
Already selling, and the group is fine.
Perfect, that is the group program. I can book you a call Thursday at 8am or Friday at 10am. Which is easier?
Thursday works. Thank you, I did not expect an answer at this hour.

props.text: Why seconds, and not an hour.

Nobody waits any more. Somebody who wants what you teach messages three people and buys from whoever answers first, not whoever is best. That is the entire contest, and it is decided before most people have opened their inbox.
Nights, weekends, holidays, while you are busy with the client in front of you. The reply does not depend on anyone being free.
The second and third follow-up go out on their own. That is where most of the recovered sales come from.
It installs into your current setup.
